name: girl-grid
title: Girl Grid
description: A five-tile support-agent bento on soft grey. A portrait under a frosted band carries a conversation that arrives bubble by bubble and starts over; the language card is a real set of switches whose chips swap for flags as you turn them on; the conversations counter sits under a bare ZepaFolder whose files fan out on hover; and the omni-channel tile floats its channels along a dashed arc that keeps tracing itself.
